_comment: Copy this file to qa-ai-flow.config.json (repo root) and fill in the
real values for your project. qa-ai-flow.config.json is gitignored —
it's project-specific, not part of this reusable tool.
backendRoot / frontendRoot are resolved relative to THIS file's own
location (the repo root qa-ai-flow/ lives in). The same two fields
cover both topologies:
Monorepo example (frontend/backend are subfolders of one repo):
backendRoot:  '../backend'
frontendRoot: '../frontend'
Split-repo example (frontend is a separate sibling repo):
backendRoot:  '.'                     (this repo IS the backend)
frontendRoot: '../../ggf-frontend'     (sibling repo, one level up)
'layout' is a human-readable label only — nothing branches on its
value, only on the resolved backendRoot/frontendRoot paths, so no
special-casing is needed per topology.
If this file is missing, CLAUDE.md's Step 0 will try cheap heuristics
first, then ask you directly rather than guessing.
stagingUrl, apiDocs, and apiBaseUrl are only needed when repo access
isn't available (the common case for QA teams without repo access —
see the playwright-from-testcases skill's
staging discovery mode). They trigger independently, not jointly:
stagingUrl is needed when frontendRoot doesn't resolve to a real,
readable directory; apiDocs/apiBaseUrl are needed when backendRoot
doesn't resolve. A project can need one without the other. Leave
them out entirely (or keep them empty, as below) when the
corresponding repo access works.
stagingUrl: base URL of the deployed frontend to browse for route/
selector discovery, e.g. 'https://staging.example.com'. Also used
as the value for BASE_URL in e2e/.env.test when staging discovery
mode is used, so generated tests' page.goto() calls resolve against
the same site discovery ran against.
apiDocs.type: 'openapi' | 'postman' | 'none'. 'none' is a valid,
explicit answer meaning discovery falls back to live-probing the
API and flags seed/teardown helpers as best-effort.
apiDocs.location: URL or file path to the OpenAPI/Swagger doc or
Postman collection. Leave empty when type is 'none'.
apiBaseUrl: base URL to probe when apiDocs.type is 'none' (live-
probing), e.g. 'https://staging.example.com/api' or a separate API
host. Leave empty when using apiDocs.location (openapi/postman) or
backend repo access instead.
